abilities.name: Card Slash
abilities.description: Once per round, when you play a card: pay 2 Hope. Your partner Digimon gains +2 to the hit roll of their next attack. This bonus expires at the start of your next turn if it hasn't been used yet.

abilities.name: Higher Draw
abilities.description: Card Slash's bonus changes from a flat +2 to 1d8 instead. Roll it fresh every time you play a card.

abilities.name: Free Draw
abilities.description: Card Slash now costs 0 Hope to play.

abilities.name: Close Enough
abilities.description: Once per encounter, when your partner Digimon's hit roll misses the target number by 3 or less, the attack grazes instead of missing outright. A graze deals half normal damage, bypasses no defenses, and triggers no additional effects from the move's tags.

abilities.name: Full Deck
abilities.description: Whenever you play Card Slash yourself, its bonus applies to both the hit roll and the damage roll, and it now benefits every allied Digimon, not just your own partner. This only triggers off your own use of Card Slash; an allied Tamer playing a card of their own does not trigger this bonus.

abilities.name: I Made You
abilities.description: Choose one Champion or Ultimate stage Digimon that doesn't require any special condition to digivolve into. Your partner Digimon can now digivolve into that chosen Digimon from any Digimon of the previous stage, even if there's normally no evolutionary link between them at all.
